description: This file defines the FieldUiTable class, a custom table element for Drupal's field UI module, including methods for pre-render processing, tree structure building, and region handling.

classes.name: FieldUiTable
classes.description: A custom Drupal render element extending the core Table class, providing specialized pre-render logic for the field UI table.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns the element's info array, including regions, theme, and pre-render callbacks.

methods.name: tablePreRender
methods.description: Performs pre-render processing on the table elements, building tree structures, setting row IDs, and attaching JS settings.

methods.name: preRenderRegionRows
methods.description: Prepares region rows for rendering, moving region data into table rows with proper colspan.

methods.name: reduceOrder
methods.description: Recursively determines the rendering order of tree nodes based on their weights and hierarchy.
